author: Ezabo
text:
Just updating from my previous viewpoints on the euro.

I've been doing similar analysis on other pairs. I won't post all the other charts, simply because I know it's easy to be an expert after the fact. At least with the Euro I've been highlighting zones in each post that I've been able to review at a later date.

So far I've been happy to analyze, watch and learn, but from next week I will be putting this more into practice. I'll run two separate demo accounts, one for scalping and one for swing trades... I think I know which one will prove more profitable!

Have a good weekend!

author: @mel
text:
Hi Tropic Trader,

I am looking at your chart and I see that the concept of s/r flip is not really clear yet. If you look on your first chart nbr 18 is a sr flip.

I will suggest you to mark other charts with just s/r flips for now, once you've done that, we'll take another step together and we'll look at another type of analysis.

S/r flip is support becoming resistance or demand becoming supply and vice versa for r/s flip.

For now, make sure to watch If's video her www.acegazette.com/en/community/jomsocia...-just-decisions.html

Try to find as much as you can and we'll discuss it further, Sounds ok for you? Mel
